claim: The ring road lights are out most nights.
mechanism: The district repair crew replaces the failing breaker and adds a second one so one fault no longer darkens the road.
authority: The district maintenance budget covers street lighting repairs.
cost: Roughly 2,000 to 4,000 in parts and labour from the repair budget.
success_metric: All lights on the ring road work for 30 nights in a row.
risks: The repair may leave the road dark for one night.
lawful_alternatives: Temporary solar lamps at the worst junctions.
